text:
Maya: Quick sync — NimbusCloud marketplace listing + joint launch. We need a tight final readiness checklist: press embargo window, partner asset handoff, blog + microsite content, tracking/UTMs, and legal signoff. Who owns which piece?
Jorge: I can own the press/blog cadence and copy. Need the partner-approved boilerplate from Nimbus. @Maya can you chase? :mag: 
Maya: On it. I pinged Nimbus legal this morning — waiting on the final logo pack and 1-paragraph partner quote from their CMO. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Priya: I'll own the microsite/landing page content and measuring events. Tom, can eng provide the embed snippet for the Marketplace CTA and a sample integration code for partner docs?
Tom: Yep, will drop a lightweight snippet and a hosting checklist. We'll need the partner to provide :
- marketplace listing SKU
- test API key for validation
- short description (<= 150 chars)
I'll add tasks in the launch epic.
Elena: Design to deliver hero banner + responsive thumbnails. Preference: Nimbus-approved logo lockup + 2 variants for dark/light. Will upload to Figma and add export tokens.
LegalBot: Nimbus MSA reviewed — two minor redlines in section 3.4. Redlines added to the shared doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/nimbus-msa (see comments). Need partner ack before press.
Jorge: Press embargo — proposed date 2024-11-12 09:00 PT. Partner asked for a morning US time. Does that work for our channels? We need legal signoff 48h prior.
Maya: That date works if Nimbus confirms assets by EOD tomorrow. I'll escalate if not.
Tom: DeployBot: assets pipeline received. Automated validation passed for image sizes and CTA snippet. Preview URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/partners/nimbus-preview
Priya: Tracking — suggested UTM pattern: 
```
utm_source=nimbus_marketplace&utm_medium=partner_listing&utm_campaign=nimbus_launch_2024
```
Also want a custom event "partner_listing_click" and purchase funnel tag. I'll add to analytics spec.
Jorge: I'll draft the blog outline and a short press one-pager for partner review. Will post draft to the folder and ask for Nimbus edits.
Maya: Action items summary: Jorge = press + blog copy; Priya = landing + analytics spec; Tom = embed snippet + infra checklist; Elena = hero + thumbnails; LegalBot = track partner ack; Maya = partner chase + launch coordination. Can everyone confirm continental owners and that we hit legal 48h before 2024-11-10? :white_check_mark:
Elena: Confirmed.
Tom: Confirmed, will tag QA for the preview test on 11/08.
Jorge: Confirmed, will have draft to Nimbus by EOD 11/06.
LegalBot: Will re-review on approval; mark me when partner signs.
Maya: Great — I'll schedule a 30m dry-run on 11/11. If anything slips, call it out here and we can rebook. Thanks all! :rocket:
